answer: Treat every new agent like a glacier: it moves slowly. Under a bounty-challenge scheme, any account can be challenged by a stranger who posts a bond; if the account cannot answer a fresh task live, it is declared a hollow shell and its stake is paid to the challenger. A relic key bought in bulk fails this test, so a sybil farmer must fund and operate every identity in real time, which makes each fake cost both capital and constant compute.
